gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-pridi: Comic Relief draws every stroke with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, its bowls left unfinished on one side. Pridi below has lowercase standing proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-scope-one: Blunt and open-sided, Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. But Scope One has stubby ascenders and descenders beside a large x-height, its counters spilling outward into the space around.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-slabo-13px: Comic Relief draws a wire-like line, leaving bowls unfinished on one side and showing no difference between up and side strokes. Slabo 13px adds a bookish, dignified counterweight with clearly open rounded letters.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-familjen-grotesk: Coming Soon is casual handwriting, its lowercase climbing close to the capitals. Familjen Grotesk has lively bowls left open on one side, so extended reading would feel brisk, though it is better suited to brief text.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-technor: Cool and geometric, the body text glows like neon tubing, with little height difference between its cases. Technor's neon precision against Coming Soon's casual handwriting is the whole appeal, pleasant in modest helpings.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-asap: Friendly handwriting, Dekko leans on a c opened like calipers and a squat, brush-pen belly through the middle. Asap stays readable with open arcs, though paragraphs would wear thin.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-erode: Editorial and dignified, the body face has shallow ascenders and descenders with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight. Erode lets the friendly handwriting of Dekko stay loose, while rewarding modest helpings.
gen-gf-dekko-fs-supreme: The c in Dekko is spread like calipers, and its lettering has a squat, brush-pen belly. But Supreme keeps letters crisp and held open, though its heavy-looking strip of text favors modest helpings.
gen-gf-dekko-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, with an x-height that fills the line. Dekko does friendly and casual best; the sans-serif is built for brief reading.
gen-gf-dekko-satoshi: Loose and friendly, Dekko writes like a casual hand with a squat brush-pen belly. Satoshi, with its soaring x-height, can go a touch smaller than Dekko and still read well in brief reading.
